g1_1_business.what_it_does: Polycab India Ltd is a leading manufacturer of wires and cables, as well as a provider of fast-moving electrical goods (FMEG) and engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) services. The company has transitioned from being primarily focused on wires and cables to becoming a diversified electrical goods powerhouse, serving various sectors including electrical infrastructure, real estate, renewables, data centers, and industrial segments.

customers.description: Companies involved in building electrical infrastructure and renewable energy projects.
Builders and developers of residential and commercial properties.
Manufacturers and industrial facilities requiring electrical solutions.

manufacturing.description: Commissioning EHV capacity for import substitution.
Manufacturing of wires, cables, and FMEG products.

competitive_advantage: Massive scale (2× the next largest competitor — KEI).
Near-total backward integration (100% in W&C, 90% in FMEG).
Extensive distribution network with 3,900+ authorized dealers.
Established brand and trust over 50+ years in the industry.
Strong market share (30-31%) in the organized W&C market.

drivers.title: EHV Capacity Commissioning
drivers.fact: CapEx committed for EHV capacity commissioning at Waghodia plant by end-CY26.
drivers.why_it_matters: This will enable import substitution and is expected to contribute to revenue from FY28.
drivers.evidence_quote: EHV is currently 50% imported; import substitution play.

drivers.title: Increasing Market Share
drivers.fact: Polycab gained ~4% market share in FY26 alone.
drivers.why_it_matters: This positions Polycab to capture a larger portion of the growing organized W&C market.
drivers.evidence_quote: Market share at 30-31% (up from 18-19% at listing).

drivers.title: BharatNet and RDSS Projects
drivers.fact: Polycab is a direct beneficiary of government schemes like BharatNet and RDSS.
drivers.why_it_matters: These projects provide significant revenue opportunities and enhance infrastructure.
